reason: A DeepSeek Harness web UI theme that changes colors, imagery, labels, icons, and selected session sounds while respecting reduced-motion settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供奶蛙风格的配色、图像、图标、文字和会话提示音主题。
summaries.en: A milk-frog-themed plugin for DeepSeek Harness that customizes web interface colors, imagery, icons, labels, and selected session sounds.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface styling and visual elements
Replaces interface icons, titles, and empty-state imagery
Plays short interface sounds during top-level session start and completion
Embeds CSS, images, and audio assets into the browser bundle
